newsitem.title: MALI: Group seeks to boost African film industry.
newsitem.headline: Group seeks to boost African film industry.

text.p: Film makers and distributors in West Africa have launched an association to boost the industry in the region and the continent as a whole, organisers say.

The West African Union of Cinema Creators and Entrepreneurs (UCECAO), which will be based in the Malian capital Bamako, came into being late on Tuesday at the end of a two-day meeting headed by Mali's culture and communication minister.
Malian film maker Souleymane Cise, several times award winner at Burkina Faso's FESPACO Panafrican film festival, will chair a five-member management committee.
The body groups French-speaking Benin, Burkina Faso, Guinea, Ivory Coast, Mali, Senegal and Togo plus English-speaking Ghana.
